source: Dr. John Watson sat near the fireplace at 221B Baker Street, listening carefully.
target: O Dr. John Watson sentou-se perto da lareira na Baker Street, 221B, ouvindo atentamente.

source: Sherlock Holmes examined the footprint with his magnifying glass.
target: Sherlock Holmes analisou a pegada através de sua lupa.

source: 'The thief was hasty,' said Holmes.
target: — O ladrão foi apressado — afirmou Holmes.

source: The train arrived at Dartmoor under heavy rain and ominous thunder.
target: O trem alcançou Dartmoor sob tempestade intensa e trovões ameaçadores.

source: She was trembling with fear in the cold corridor.
target: Ela tremia de pavor no corredor gélido.

source: He carefully inspected the ancient brass lock on the mahogany door.
target: Ele examinou com cautela a velha fechadura de latão na porta de mogno.

source: The witness confirmed the statement before the magistrate.
target: A testemunha confirmou o depoimento perante o magistrado.

source: Inspector Lestrade had sent an urgent telegram regarding the blackwood sapphire.
target: O inspetor Lestrade despachara um telegrama urgente relativo à safira de Blackwood.

source: The sapphire vanished at midnight from the heavy iron safe in the master bedroom.
target: A safira sumiu.

source: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson walked through the foggy streets of London discussing the strange disappearance of Lord Blackwood.
target: Eles caminharam.

source: She looked out the window.
target: Ela olhou pela janela contemplando os vastos campos verdes onde os cavalos pastavam alegremente sob a luz dourada do sol poente de outono.

source: The prisoner was found guilty by the jury.
target: O prisioneiro foi considerado inocente pelo júri.

source: The governor approved the expedition into the unknown jungle.
target: O governador rejeitou a expedição para a selva desconhecida.

source: Holmes did not touch the weapon on the table.
target: Holmes tocou na arma sobre a mesa.

source: The butler remembered the exact time of arrival.
target: O mordomo não se lembrou do horário exato de chegada.

source: Holmes asked Watson about the mysterious footprint.
target: Watson perguntou a Holmes sobre a pegada misteriosa.

source: He stared into the darkness.
target: Ela encarou a escuridão.

source: Lord Blackwood was furious when the safe was opened.
target: Lord Blackwood estava chateado quando o cofre foi aberto.

source: Lady Margaret was terrified by the ghostly hound.
target: Lady Margaret estava preocupada com o cão fantasmagórico.

source: He suffered excruciating pain in his injured leg.
target: Ele sentiu dor incômoda na perna machucada.

source: Actually, the thief did not leave through the main garden door.
target: Atualmente, o ladrão não saiu pela porta principal do jardim.

source: He did not realize that the footprints belonged to a hound.
target: Ele não realizou que as pegadas pertenciam a um cão de caça.

source: His parents lived in Dartmoor for many decades.
target: Seus parentes viveram em Dartmoor por muitas décadas.

source: Eventually, the inspector understood the truth.
target: Eventualmente, o inspetor compreendeu a verdade.
